invites_project_role_check.name: invites_project_role_check
invites_project_role_check.value: project_role IS NULL OR project_role IN ('lead', 'member', 'viewer')

orgs_ai_provider_check.name: orgs_ai_provider_check
orgs_ai_provider_check.value: ai_provider IS NULL OR ai_provider IN ('anthropic', 'openai_compatible')

tags_name_check.name: tags_name_check
tags_name_check.value: name GLOB '[a-z0-9]*' AND name NOT GLOB '*[^a-z0-9-]*' AND length(name) BETWEEN 1 AND 24

task_estimates_level_check.name: task_estimates_level_check
task_estimates_level_check.value: level IS NULL OR level IN ('XS', 'S', 'M', 'L', 'XL')

task_estimates_level_present_check.name: task_estimates_level_present_check
task_estimates_level_present_check.value: level IS NOT NULL OR source = 'person'

tasks_discovered_from_check.name: tasks_discovered_from_check
tasks_discovered_from_check.value: discovered_from IS NULL OR discovered_from <> id

tasks_parent_task_id_check.name: tasks_parent_task_id_check
tasks_parent_task_id_check.value: parent_task_id IS NULL OR parent_task_id <> id
